description.value: The Local is a waterfront restaurant and bar on Victoria's inner harbour, marketing itself as 'Victoria's Sunniest Patio' with a large outdoor patio on Wharf Street. The menu leans into BC pub fare — smash burgers, Pacific halibut and chips, wings, nachos — backed by a strong lineup of local Victoria and Vancouver Island craft beers on draught. Its prime location along a popular cycling and pedestrian corridor makes it a natural mid-ride or post-ride destination.
